subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this Codex warning-policy PR require live Codex app-server proof before merge, or is source-contract inspection plus focused OpenClaw helper tests sufficient?
rationale: The source contract and fix shape are strong, but the affected user-visible warning route has not been shown in a real Codex app-server turn and current OpenClaw projection evidence leaves a producer-path gap.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording that shows both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior after the patch.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the upstream Codex source contract and focused tests as enough despite the missing live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause or close after the cleanup window
options.body: If no proof or branch refresh arrives after the full inactivity window, close as stalled-unproven and keep the canonical issue open for a replacement fix.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording that shows both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior after the patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and prior review context point to this handle as the closest owner for the shared agent warning/mutation path.
